title: Collections Desk Note: Delinquency Allowance in Good-Faith Days
content:
A deferral qualifying payment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts also carries a good-faith amount, applied to principal, equal to one day's interest on the principal balance at the contract APR over the tier's day-count basis multiplied by the good-faith days and rounded to the cent.

The good-faith days are raised by a delinquency allowance counted in calendar days from the next due date on the contract record to the payment date.

| Days past due on the payment date | Days added |
|---|---|
| 16 or more | late-stage good-faith days: 5 |
| 1 to 15 | early-stage good-faith days: 2 |
| not yet past due (the payment date is on or before the next due date) | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, next due date 2026-08-01)

| Payment date | Days past due | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-01 | 0 | none |
| 2026-08-02 | 1 | 2 |
| 2026-08-16 | 15 | 2 |
| 2026-08-17 | 16 | 5 |

Hypothetical: good-faith days of 30 on a payment made 20 days past due become 35.
